title: Ontology catalog
description: The catalog of ontologies (N-050): one file, docs/ontology-catalog.json, lists every name@function scope with its own version, owner, status and imports. Seeded with one scope per function (gate G5, Torian 2026-11-05). That each scope's suffix is a function id and its owner, that imports are acyclic and that every term a scope uses is defined in it or in a scope it imports is checked by node schema/terms/catalog-test.ts, not here. mappings names the SKOS and OWL term for each class and field, or none.

catalog.note: a list of concept schemes, not a scheme itself

scope.note: a term name@function exports as function:name, with the function id as the scheme's namespace prefix; the written syntax stays name@function
the scheme's IRI is minted from it

status.note: owl:deprecated is true when status is retired

scope.description: One name@function scope. Its terms are the live nouns in docs/ontology.json whose function is the suffix.

owner.description: The function id that owns the scope; it must be the scope's suffix.

imports.description: The scopes whose terms this scope may use.
